newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MICROLINK TURNOVER INCREASES BY 79 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: MICROLINK TURNOVER INCREASES BY 79 PERCENT.

text.p: Estonia's biggest computer company Microlink turnover grew by 79 percent in the first quarter, compared to the same period last year, to 86.9 million kroons, the company said on Thursday.
Microlink has 11.7 percent market share in the Baltic states. The company had turnover of 211.8 million kroons last year and predicts to turn over 340 million kroons this year.
The rapid growth in turnover was due to increasing demand in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, the company said in a statement.
Microlink produced 2,929 computers in the first quarter and sold 25 percent of them in the other Baltic states.
